intervention_execution.claim: Phase 9F and Phase 9G ran only post-inference oracle context probes after frozen QORE plus Answer Scorer K=5 selection; Phase 10C changed decoder energy but did not change utility.

intended_intermediate.claim: The unmeasured causal link is whether support is distributed across the already selected K=5 passages, including a member with no answer literal, rather than residing in an answer-bearing passage alone.

observable_output.claim: Phase 9G's answer-bearing-passage oracle found zero multi-passage evidence cases, but it did not enumerate all selected-set subsets or retain non-answer-bearing members.

task_utility.claim: No tested label-free reader or retrieval intervention transferred conditional headroom to all-question utility, so this recovery action must remain observational.

primary_explanation.statement: The Phase 9F/9G residual may be a support-topology blind spot: their answer-bearing-only constructions can remove a non-answer literal passage that is necessary jointly with another selected passage.

alternative_explanations.statement: The residual truly lies beyond the selected K=5 set, so every selected-set subset will fail despite a successful gold-copy control.
A singleton selected passage can suffice under the frozen generator, so no distributed support mechanism is needed.
Any apparent multi-passage effect may involve only answer-bearing passages and would therefore not test the unmeasured non-answer-member mechanism.

discriminating_measurement.uncertainty: Existing diagnostics did not test complete selected-set subset topology while preserving the original selected passage order.
discriminating_measurement.measurement: For each selected-hit baseline EM error with successful gold-copy control, enumerate all 31 non-empty ordered subsets of the frozen selected K=5 context and record scalar outcomes plus answer-match-count topology.
discriminating_measurement.primary_outcome: All singleton subsets fail and at least one successful multi-passage subset contains a selected passage with no gold-answer literal; this is strict non-answer-assisted distributed support.
discriminating_measurement.alternative_outcome: A successful singleton, a multi-passage success containing only answer-bearing members, or no successful subset separates singleton sufficiency, already-covered answer-bearing interaction, and beyond-selected-set failure.

forbidden_rescue_variants: reader-energy coefficient, span-count, threshold, or extra-slice retuning
answer-bearing-passage aggregation or wider Top-50 answer oracle restatements
any online selector, retrieval, generator, prompt, evaluator, label, or answer-path mutation

positive_carryovers.mechanism: In both prior diagnostics, selected-hit baseline errors had a successful deterministic gold-copy control, so the frozen generator can realize an answer when the post-inference oracle construction is sufficient.
positive_carryovers.transport_constraint: The carryover supports only post-inference measurement; gold answers and evaluator outputs must never reach selection, retrieval, prompting, or decoding.

selected_candidate.title: Minimal selected-set support-topology diagnostic
selected_candidate.causal_difference: Instead of mutating a reader, candidate ranker, retrieval depth, or answer-bearing context, this candidate measures whether a non-answer literal selected member is jointly necessary in a successful minimal subset.
selected_candidate.discriminating_measurement: Strict non-answer-assisted distributed-set interaction rate with a question-cluster bootstrap lower bound.
selected_candidate.success_gate: On validation[1800:1850], at least 40% of gold-copy-eligible questions show strict non-answer-assisted distributed support and the 95% bootstrap lower bound is at least 20%; validation[1850:1900] must independently meet the same gate.
selected_candidate.kill_condition: Insufficient eligibility, either slice below the fraction or lower-bound gate, failure to preserve selected context/order, or any need for gold/evaluator feedback before generation closes this selector direction without tuning or online mutation.
selected_candidate.authorization_boundary: Authorized only for synthetic/config validation and a future collaborator-run observation-only diagnostic; a pass authorizes a separate method portfolio review, not a selector implementation.

limitations: A successful subset is an oracle headroom observation and remains L0 diagnostic evidence.
Exhaustive K=5 subset probing is intentionally too expensive and gold-dependent for inference-time use.
The diagnostic does not establish that a future label-free topology estimator exists or improves all-question utility.
